svg.title: firstmate-workflow
svg.desc: A captain at the helm of a flagship at dusk. A decision card rises beside the captain and is stamped approved, while a fleet of AI crew ships sails out to several islands and one arrives in port under fireworks. Command a fleet of AI engineers. You decide; they ship, with proof.

g.text: Command a fleet of AI engineers.
You decide; they ship, with proof.
